---
# ocp-lakehouse-bench: three-tier lakehouse benchmark lab on AWS
cloud_provider: ec2
env_type: lakehouse-bench

__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: Lakehouse Benchmark Lab
    category: Workshops
  deployer:
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: main

# Instance sizing (vCPU per instance in the comments)
bastion_instance_type: m6i.xlarge        # 4 vCPU
control_instance_count: 3
control_instance_type: m6i.2xlarge       # 8 vCPU
worker_instance_count: 3
worker_instance_type: m6i.4xlarge        # 16 vCPU

lakehouse_bench_dataset: tpcds-sf1000

answer:
The CloudFormation stack lakehouse-bench-wd4kx failed with CREATE_FAILED on resource worker2, error code VcpuLimitExceeded: "You have requested more vCPU capacity than your current vCPU limit of 64 allows". So the account's vCPU limit for this instance bucket is 64.

The sizing comes from the catalog item, not from the config defaults. rhpds/agnosticv:analytics_bu/ocp-lakehouse-bench/common.yaml:19 sets worker_instance_type: m6i.4xlarge (16 vCPU) with worker_instance_count: 3, plus control_instance_count: 3 of m6i.2xlarge (8 vCPU) and one m6i.xlarge bastion (4 vCPU). That is 3 x 16 + 3 x 8 + 4 = 76 vCPUs requested, which is 12 more than the 64 vCPU limit. The stack failed at the worker instances because they are the last and largest to be created.

Root cause: the item's instance sizing needs 76 vCPUs in an account whose limit is 64. Fix by raising the account's vCPU quota to at least 76 or by shrinking the worker size or count in common.yaml.

Category: resource_failure. Confidence: high.
